page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-4-lssd is a virtual machine instance belonging to the c4n server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 15.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 3.75 GB of RAM per core.

This instance features bundled local storage consisting of a single NVMe SSD with a capacity of 403 GB. It does not include any integrated graphics processing units, meaning all computational tasks rely entirely on the dedicated x86_64 central processing unit. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the balanced ratio of 3.75 GB of memory per vCPU and the inclusion of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage, this instance is designed for workloads requiring fast local read and write operations. Suitable use cases include small to medium database hosting, local caching layers, and general-purpose applications that benefit from low-latency ephemeral storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource sharing.
